title: Analytical Run Receipt
description: Immutable receipt capturing exactly how an answer was produced, for reproducibility and audit. Cache keys derive from this receipt (snapshot + policy + profile + model + prompt + tenant). Reconciled from handoff-audit/phase1-design/schemas/analytical_run_receipt.v1.schema.json against docs/spatialrag_migration/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §4/§10 (see schemas/contracts/README.md).

retrieval_profile.description: Replaces the original draft's inline {profile_id, weights, hyde_enabled} object with a full $ref to the richer retrieval_profile/v1 contract (8 named signals + starter profiles) per DATA_CONTRACTS.md §4.

ocr.description: Added per DATA_CONTRACTS.md §10's OCRProvider abstraction — absent from the original draft.

geocoder.description: Added per DATA_CONTRACTS.md §10's GeocoderProvider abstraction — absent from the original draft.

provider_config.description: Replaces the original draft's loosely-typed llm/embedding/reranker slots (bare nullable objects, plus top-level model_id/prompt_version strings) with typed provider_reference/v1 references carrying model_revision/prompt_template_version/system_policy_version/temperature.

x-invariants: Exact-ID and structured search MUST succeed with llm == null (no LLM dependency for structured search).
No model context may bypass access policy: access_context governs which evidence_ids may enter the prompt.
hyde_enabled is read from retrieval_profile.hyde_enabled; the default starter profiles all set it false.
